verdict.rationale: There is no explicit no-training policy or opt-out in the evidence. The only support is indirect: Activepieces lets you bring your own AI keys and run it on your own infrastructure or inside your own network. That keeps data under your control and the provider relationship your own, but it does not by itself guarantee your data is excluded from model training. Missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement that customer data is not used for training, a documented training opt-out or data-retention control, and independent corroboration.
